title: SR5 Detached Window Compatibility Fix
description:
Makes Shadowrun 5e (SR5-FoundryVTT) character sheets work correctly in a detached/popped-out browser window.

Fix 1: Foundry v14's native "Detach Window" moves the sheet into another browser window, which re-links every element to that window's JavaScript realm. SR5 guards ~88 of its interaction handlers with instanceof HTMLElement, which silently returns false across realms, so skills and most other controls stop responding with no error. This module makes those checks realm-aware.

Fix 2: When the PopOut! module is used instead, SR5's roll dialog opens in the wrong window because PopOut! cannot tell which actor it belongs to. This module supplies the missing link.

recommends.reason: This module has no effect unless PopOut! is also installed and active.
